name: hud_ui_mgr_update_target_reticle_from_cursor
description: HudUiMgr::UpdateTargetReticleFromCursor hides, shows, or projects the target reticle from normalized cursor coordinates through camera/raycast state.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x411270 validates reticleMode 0/1 visibility, mode-2 normalized cursor mapping, projected x/y storage, reticle widget positioning and clipping, atexit registration, replicated-screen mapping, near/far unprojection, projectile-attached raycastability handling, raycast miss/default-image path, world hit-point output, render-bound clamp, and zClipAlt target rect update.

The native smoke covers hidden/visible reticle modes and a mode-2 raycast-miss path that verifies projected coordinates, widget position, image selection, clip rect, world-hit output, projection depth, raycastability restore behavior, and alternate clip target bounds.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x411270 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a HUD manager/source-cluster pass.
